# Appendix map

| Appendix | Role | Supports |
|---|---|---|
| A — Rooted tree gauge | uniqueness and exact Haar disintegration | Section 2.1 |
| B — Exact linear algebra | incidence definitions, retained rank, LDL and Bareiss floors | Section 3 |
| C — Heat-kernel bounds | product-log calculus, paired images, block chain rule | Section 4 |
| D — Marginal proofs | differentiation, Brascamp--Lieb, transport on convex body | Section 5 |
| E — Certificate format | schema and trusted kernel | Section 6 |

The appendix order is topological: quotient precedes linear algebra, which
precedes nonlinear action, which precedes marginalization.
